subject: The secret mistake I discovered in your conversations
preview_text: I only share this with actual users. Not on social media. This changes how you see every text.
body_paragraphs: I was reviewing some anonymized data from the app this week, and I saw a pattern that made me stop. It's a subtle thing, something you'd never notice on your own. But once you see it, you can't unsee it. And it explains why you sometimes feel that gut punch after a 'normal' chat.

I'm only sharing this here because you're an actual user. This isn't for likes or shares. It's the kind of insight I'd tell a close friend who was in the thick of it. It's about the space between the lines—the timing, the one-word replies that aren't just busy, the questions that aren't really questions. It's the hidden language of disengagement.

This is exactly what the Pattern Detection feature was built to catch. It doesn't just look at one screenshot. It connects the dots across your conversations and flags these subtle, repeating behaviors that slowly drain your energy. It shows you the rhythm of avoidance or hot-and-cold cycles that feel confusing in the moment.

Open the app and run a Pattern Check on your last few conversations with that person. Don't just look at the toxicity score—look at the behavioral timeline it builds. See the pattern emerge. P.S. The users who do this within 48 hours of a weird feeling report the highest 'aha' moments. It's like getting your vision cleared.
